about.subtitle: Learn about the Student Welfare Fund and our mission to support education
about.intro: The Student Welfare Fund is a national initiative that supports students in need to complete their education. Through generous donations and partnerships we work hand in hand to ease financial burden and empower students to achieve their aspirations.
about.missionText: To provide financial and moral support to university students in need so they can continue and complete their studies, based on our belief that education is a right for all.
about.visionText: An equitable educational community where every student can pursue their education without financial barriers, and our students are the leaders of tomorrow.
about.value1Text: We are committed to disclosing how donations are used and the results of our programs to build trust with donors and the community.
about.value2Text: We believe that supporting students is a shared responsibility between individuals and institutions for lasting impact.
about.value3Text: We aim to empower students to complete their education, not just provide temporary assistance.
about.value4Text: We work with supporting institutions and partners to expand the scope of care and increase impact.
about.ctaSubtext: Every donation counts — join thousands of donors supporting student education.
